components.name: Save Action
components.description: Full-width action for saving a valid changed revision, with the drawn SVG save mark.
components.css: .ds-save { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 39px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--navy); background: var(--navy); color: #fff; font: 560 11px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms ease, border-color 130ms ease; } .ds-save svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-save:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #17252e; background: #17252e; } .ds-save:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f627a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-save:disabled { border-color: #cfd3ce; background: #dce0db; color: var(--muted); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: CSV Export
components.description: Compact bordered secondary action for exporting the saved revision.
components.css: .ds-export { display: inline-flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cfd4ce; background: #f6f7f3; color: #394344; font: 400 10px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 130ms ease, color 130ms ease; } .ds-export svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; } .ds-export:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #e9ece6; } .ds-export:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f627a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-export:disabled { color: var(--muted); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Dimension Field
components.description: Ruled, axis-labelled numeric entry with a stable millimeter suffix.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 0 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: #555e5e; font: 400 11px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-field-label small { color: var(--muted); font: 500 8px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-value { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; } .ds-value input { width: 100%; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #202729; font: 500 20px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-value input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f627a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-value span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 9px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-field.has-error .ds-value input, .ds-field .ds-error { color: var(--accent-deep); }

components.name: Work Panel
components.description: Major paper-toned work surface with a fine border and shared low lift.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 21px 20px 14px; border: 1px solid #dbddd7; background: var(--paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow); color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-panel strong { color: #283033; font: 600 16px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Revision Ticket
components.description: Segmented saved-revision identity with an explicit local-demo reference.
components.html:
REVISÃO ATUALR01 SALVA07 de nov. · 17:08
DEMO-R01
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(178px, 1fr) 1px 114px; width: 352px; min-height: 74px; border: 1px solid #d4d7d1; background: #f4f4f0; color: var(--ink); transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-ticket.changed { border-color: #d89c8e; } .ds-ticket-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 10px 15px; } .ds-ticket small { color: var(--muted); font: 500 9px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-ticket strong { margin-top: 5px; font: 500 18px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: -.06em; } .ds-ticket strong span { padding: 4px 5px; background: #e6e9e3; color: #5d6862; font-size: 8px; } .ds-ticket i { position: relative; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, #cfd2cd 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px); } .ds-ticket-code { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; padding: 9px; } .ds-ticket-code b { width: 76px; height: 20px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #24292c 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px, #24292c 3px 4px, transparent 4px 6px); }

components.name: Dimension Rail
components.description: Three equal axis-coded measurements attached directly to the model stage.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); min-height: 56px; border-top: 1px solid #daddd7; background: #f4f5f1; } .ds-rail > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 17px 1fr auto 18px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 12px; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-rail > div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-rail b { display: grid; width: 16px; height: 16px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #cfd4ce; color: var(--muted); font: 400 8px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-rail small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 8px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-rail strong { color: #2e3738; font: 500 14px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Material Indicator
components.description: Flat neutral MDF indicator beside the thickness stepper.
components.css: .ds-material { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-swatch { width: 27px; height: 27px; border: 1px solid #8a928d; background: #d9dcd6; } .ds-material > span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-material small { color: var(--muted); font: 500 9px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-material strong { color: #3a4241; font: 550 11px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: View Switcher
components.description: Four compact model-view buttons with a clear active segment.
components.css: .ds-switcher { display: flex; height: 30px; border: 1px solid #d9dcd6; background: #f0f1ed; } .ds-switcher button { display: grid; width: 31px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #d9dcd6; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-switcher button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-switcher svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-switcher button:hover { background: #e4e6e1; color: #384246; } .ds-switcher button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #fff; color: var(--navy); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px var(--navy); } .ds-switcher button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #2f627a; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Parts Table
components.description: Compact bill-of-parts rows with neutral hover and coral selection feedback.
components.css: .ds-parts { width: 100%; min-width: 690px; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; font: 400 10px 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-parts th { height: 31px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dbd5; color: var(--muted); font: 500 8px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .07em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-parts td { height: 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e6e1; color: #525c5b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-parts tbody tr { transition: background 100ms ease; } .ds-parts tbody tr:hover { background: #eef0eb; } .ds-parts tbody tr.ds-selected { background: #f6e8e3; } .ds-parts tbody tr.ds-selected td { color: #823c31; } .ds-parts td:first-child span { display: inline-block; min-width: 48px; padding: 4px 5px; border: 1px solid #d5d9d3; background: #f2f3ef; color: #43504e; font: 400 9px 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; text-align: center; }

narrative.northStar: The Revision Ticket and Departures Board
narrative.overview:
The interface turns a counter edit into a legible shop-floor record: measured values, one geometric model, a parts list, and a clearly numbered saved revision. A segmented revision ticket and compact technical indexing give the work a procedural, record-like character without implying transportation or scanning functionality.

The shipped visual language is precise and paper-like: a cool grey-green canvas, pale work surfaces, hairline dividers, dark ink, and a restrained coral signal. The project is explicitly a local demonstration; revision and model references carry `DEMO` identifiers rather than suggesting synchronization or a production system.
keyCharacteristics: Project identity, demonstration status, and saved revision remain visible together.
Dimensions and parts use stable, tabular-looking numeric presentation.
Coral marks meaningful changed, selected, or validation states only.
At mobile widths, editable dimensions precede the model and its readouts.

rules.name: The Change Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for meaningful changed, selected, or validation states; it is not an always-on decorative accent.

rules.name: The Stable Figure Rule
rules.body: Keep dimensions, counts, and revision identifiers in tabular numeric presentation so changing values remain easy to scan.

rules.name: The Specification-First Mobile Rule
rules.body: On mobile, editable dimensions come before the model; do not reverse that sequence.

rules.name: The Paper-First Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and fine borders for structure; reserve the soft shadow for major work panels rather than small controls.

dos: Do keep model dimensions, parts, and the saved revision visually associated.
Do make the local demonstration and `DEMO` revision references explicit.
Do use tabular figures for dimensions, counts, and revision identifiers.
Do use coral only for meaningful changed, selected, or validation states.
Do keep editable dimensions before the model at mobile widths.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and clear disabled states.
donts: Don't imply that the reference strip can be scanned; it is decorative identification only.
Don't present the local demonstration as synchronized, persisted, or production-released.
Don't use coral as a persistent decorative color.
Don't force the parts table's columns below their readable minimum; use horizontal overflow.
Don't turn the one-off neutral MDF indicator or rendered model tones into reusable interface palette tokens.
